annotations.title: Cable size, voltage drop and earth fault loop check

description: Sizes a UK final circuit or sub-main and shows the working: design current (with cooker diversity), protective device rating, the smallest cable size that passes current-carrying capacity, voltage drop (3% lighting, 5% other) and earth fault loop impedance (Zs against the maximum for B, C or D breakers), plus a cpc adiabatic check. Returns `recommended` (size and every check with status pass, fail, indicative_pass, needs_input), `sizes_considered` (one line per size), `must_check_against_regs` (points the electrician confirms in BS 7671) and sources. Current-carrying capacity comes from a cautious heat-flow model, not BS 7671 tables, so it is marked indicative; give `cable_size_mm2` plus `tabulated_capacity_a` from the regs for a firm check. Voltage drop and Zs are calculated from physics and are firm for the inputs given. Typical call: a 9.5 kW shower on an 18 m run clipped direct: {"circuit_type":"shower","load_kw":9.5,"run_length_m":18,"installation_method":"clipped_direct"}.

ambient_c.description: Ambient temperature, C. Defaults to 30 in air, 20 in the ground.

apply_cooker_diversity.description: Cooker only: apply the usual domestic cooker diversity (default true).

armour_resistance_mohm_per_m.description: SWA armour resistance from the cable datasheet, milliohms per metre, when the armour is the cpc.

cable_size_mm2.description: Check this specific size as well as finding the smallest that passes.

cable_type.description: Defaults to twin_and_earth, or swa_xlpe for buried runs and sub-mains.

circuit_type.description: What the circuit feeds. ring_final and radial_sockets can be sized without a load (the device rating is used).

cooker_has_socket.description: Cooker only: the cooker control unit has a socket outlet.

cores.description: SWA only: number of cores. Defaults to 3 single phase (spare core as cpc) or 4 three phase. With 2 the armour is the cpc: give armour_resistance_mohm_per_m.

cpc_size_mm2.description: Override the circuit protective conductor size (twin and earth sizes are known).

design_current_a.description: Design current Ib in amps, if already known. Overrides load_kw.

grouped_circuits.description: Number of circuits bunched together along the run, including this one. Defaults to 1.

grouping_factor.description: Grouping factor Cg from the regs for the arrangement, if known. Without it Spark Pack uses a cautious estimate.

installation_method.description: How the cable is run. clipped_direct: Clipped direct to a wall or surface, in free air; in_conduit_or_trunking_on_wall: In conduit or trunking fixed on a wall; in_conduit_in_insulated_wall: In conduit in a thermally insulated wall; touching_insulation_one_side: In a stud wall or ceiling void, touching thermal insulation on one side; surrounded_by_insulation: Totally surrounded by thermal insulation (deep loft insulation, insulated stud wall); above_ceiling_insulation_under_100mm: Clipped to a joist above a plasterboard ceiling, insulation 100 mm or less, cable not covered; buried_direct: Buried direct in the ground (about 0.7 m deep); in_duct_underground: In a duct in the ground (about 0.7 m deep). If the run passes through several, give the worst one (usually insulation).

load_kw.description: Load in kW (for example 9.5 for a shower, 7.4 for a 32 A EV charger). Give this or design_current_a.

power_factor.description: Defaults to 1 (resistive loads, EV chargers). Use about 0.95 for heat pumps or mixed sub-main loads.

protective_device.description: The breaker or fuse. Leave rating_a out to let Spark Pack choose the smallest standard rating at or above the design current.

run_length_m.description: Cable length from the board to the furthest point, metres. For a ring, the total ring length.

soil_thermal_resistivity.description: Buried runs: soil thermal resistivity K.m/W, defaults to 2.5 (cautious).

tabulated_capacity_a.description: Tabulated current-carrying capacity It for cable_size_mm2 and this method, read from BS 7671 Appendix 4 by the electrician. Makes the capacity check firm.

trade.description: Optional. The electrician's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to prefill certificate contractor fields and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Spark Pack.

address.description: Business address for the certificate contractor block.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Bright Sparks Electrical".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme the business is registered with.

upstream_voltage_drop_percent.description: Voltage drop already used upstream (for a circuit fed from a sub-board), percent.

ze_ohms.description: Measured external earth fault loop impedance Ze, ohms. Without it the typical network maximum is used (0.35 TN-C-S, 0.8 TN-S).
